entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have a VeloBand GPS tracker, and I... I think I need to return it. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it's not broken. It's just... we had a family emergency right after I got it. My husband was rushed to the hospital and needed an unexpected surgery. It was all very sudden.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well.

Thank you. And on top of that, my son's overseas deployment got moved up, so we were dealing with that too. The box is still unopened. I just feel so overwhelmed and I know I've missed the window. Can't you just help me?
That is a lot to handle at once. I completely understand. Let me pull up your account and our policy. I see here you received the item 26 days ago. One moment while I check the details.
See, 26 days. I knew it was too late. I just don't know what to do.
Actually, you have nothing to worry about. I'm looking at our policy right now, and all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe.
Wait, really? 90 days? Oh, thank goodness. I was so stressed about this. That's a huge relief.

Absolutely. I'm happy to process that return for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just place the item in its original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Wow. Okay. That's so much simpler than I thought. Thank you, Charlie. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. I hope things get easier for you and your family. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
